Details.title: Details
Details.description:
The full test-drive-scheduler payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this:

{"title":"Book a test drive","vehicle":{"name":"Electric SUV","trim":"RS AWD · Radiant Red","imageUrl":"","initials":"EV"},"location":{"name":"Downtown Dealership","address":"500 Market St, San Francisco"},"days":[{"date":"2026-09-16","slots":[{"id":"a","time":"09:30","driveType":"showroom"},{"id":"b","time":"13:00","driveType":"at_home"}]},{"date":"2026-09-17","slots":[{"id":"c","time":"10:00","driveType":"showroom"},{"id":"d","time":"15:30","driveType":"showroom"}]},{"date":"2026-09-18","slots":[{"id":"e","time":"11:00","driveType":"at_home"},{"id":"f","time":"16:00","driveType":"showroom"}]},{"date":"2026-09-21","slots":[{"id":"g","time":"09:00","driveType":"showroom"},{"id":"h","time":"14:00","driveType":"at_home"}]},{"date":"2026-09-22","slots":[{"id":"i","time":"10:30","driveType":"showroom"},{"id":"j","time":"17:00","driveType":"showroom"}]}],"submitText":"Book test drive"}

Rules:
- 'title' (string, optional): heading. Defaults to 'Book a test drive'.
- 'vehicle' (object, optional): { 'name' (string, REQUIRED when present — the model being driven); 'trim' (string, optional — trim/color line); 'imageUrl' (string, optional — a full https image URL; falls back to initials if it fails to load); 'initials' (string, optional — 1-2 letters shown when there is no image) }.
- 'location' (object, optional): { 'name' (string), 'address' (string) } — the dealership.
- 'days' (array, REQUIRED): each { 'date' (string, REQUIRED — ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'); 'slots' (array, REQUIRED) of { 'id' (string, REQUIRED — sent back on selection); 'time' (string, REQUIRED — 24h 'HH:MM', rendered as '1:30 PM'); 'driveType' (string, optional — one of showroom | at_home; drives the slot glyph + hue) } }. Do NOT emit empty days or empty slot arrays.
- 'submitText' (string, optional): confirm-button label; defaults to 'Book test drive'. The customer taps a time slot to select it, then this button books it.

Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
